rounds.kick: One of these is actually TRUE. Can you spot it?

statements.text: Australian rower Chris Morgan won three Olympic medals before being diagnosed with autism, which is why his condition never affected his career.
statements.reveal: Chris Morgan is a three-time Olympian and won bronze at London 2012 — but he says his autism helped him succeed: "Autism made me successful."

statements.text: Love 21 spent just 15% of its budget on administrative overhead last year.
statements.reveal: The real figure is 6% — Love 21 directs the rest of every dollar to its programmes for members and families.
This has been thoroughly debunked. There is no link between vaccines and autism.
